items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And so he took me and Snake, the trumpet player, Roy White, and the banjo player, Landers.

ctx.x: Yeah, right from the records. And this band, we played around there with Minneapolis for, oh, maybe four or five months, whatever it was. And finally a fellow named Clarence Johnson who had a -- was a piano player, he got a job up in a hotel up in Bismark, North Dakota for the winter at the Spencer Hotel. And so he took me and Snake, the trumpet player, Roy White, and the banjo player, Landers. And he had a drummer from St. Paul, which I don't remember his name, five pieces and we went up to Bismark.
What do they do in the winter in Bismark, North Dakota?
